newsitem.title: POLAND: Warsaw bourse says ready for trade in warrants.
newsitem.headline: Warsaw bourse says ready for trade in warrants.

text.p: The Warsaw Stock Exchange is prepared to trade in warrants, bourse president Wieslaw Rozlucki told daily Parkiet in its Saturday edition.

"The best sort of education for and dissemination of that type of instrument is its trade on the exchange....For three years we've been waiting for issuers. I hope that soon warrants will appear on the bourse," Parkiet quoted Rozlucki as saying.
Poland's Bank Rozwoju Exportu SA (BRE) said earlier in the week that last Thursday it would issue 350 American call warrants for 100 NFI units each to individual investors.
Parkiet said half of them had already been sold.
The bourse has said it seeks to list futures on its blue-chip WIG 20 index as early as this year's third quarter and to introduce share options in the second half of next year.
BRE has also issued call warrants for shares in industrial and trading conglomerate Elektrim and steel trader Stalexport.
